title: Partial Resolution Check signal assembly prose in run.skill.md superseded by write_signal
description: run.skill.md's Partial Resolution Check (~15 lines) contains an inline signal assembly block constructing an Error/Major signal field-by-field, followed by a reference to the Canonical Signal Dedup-and-Write Procedure. Once write_signal is available, the assembly and write collapse to a single tool call supplying the field values inline. The full assembly prose becomes dead-weight context on every run prompt, adding lines whose only purpose is to describe an operation that a kernel tool handles atomically.
proposed_resolution: After write_signal (a1000113-0613-4000-8000-000000000113) is implemented, replace the signal assembly block and Dedup-and-Write reference in the Partial Resolution Check with a single write_signal call supplying { category: 'Error', severity: 'Major', title: 'Partial resolution: <domain>/<slug>', description: '...', proposed_resolution: '...' } inline. Reduce the total Partial Resolution Check prose from ~15 lines to ~5.
